contract.booleanTiePolicy: even-odd profile winding; horizontal bands use lower-inclusive upper-exclusive crossings; equal-x crossings preserve source edge order
contract.floatingPointPolicy: IEEE-754 f64 scalar source order; no fast-math, contraction, SIMD, threads, exceptions or tail calls
contract.allocationPolicy: Counts owned binary/backing stores only; point and edge metadata used by the untimed correctness oracle are excluded. JavaScript owns eight backing stores; fixed-memory Wasm performs no semantic allocation.
contract.counterPolicy: Boolean intersection tests count every cylinder boundary sample tested against the filleted box. Scan intersection tests count every B-rep edge tested in every horizontal band. Triangle and tessellation-vertex counters come from the complete emitted mesh.

targets.semanticWork: Authored JavaScript constructs the box and cylinder B-rep loops, executes both boolean cuts and four fillets, builds scan-band intersections, and emits the complete tessellation.
Authored C compiled to fixed-memory linear Wasm independently constructs the complete B-rep and tessellation; JavaScript copies only the 128-byte feature-tree fixture and decodes the complete output.
